name: Operating cycle
expression: Operating cycle = Days of inventory on hand + Days sales outstanding
meaning: Measures the time from acquiring inventory through collecting cash from its sale, before recognizing supplier financing.
intuition: The operating cycle follows inventory into a sale and then a receivable; unlike the cash conversion cycle, it does not subtract days payable outstanding.
workedExample: Aster Retail has 38 inventory days and 27 receivable days. Its operating cycle is 38 + 27 = 65 days.
commonMistake: Subtracting days payable outstanding and thereby calculating the cash conversion cycle instead.
relatedLearningOutcome: explain the cash conversion cycle and compare issuers’ cash conversion cycles
